decision: Intentional changes from reviewed fixes, permitted by plugin-defined standalone CC/R lowering (§17.4). No resolved comparison-link layout is changed: hasComparisonLayout/comparisonHeapBase retain its supplied addresses. §4.4 requires unique function identity; the reservation applies only when that external link map is absent. §19.5 requires maximum budget-table heap capacity, retained by 6091986. No published L reference object or golden changes.
review: docs/reviews/2026-11-06-quality-plugin-r2.md (CLEAR, with critical-batch council review still required); subsequent council blockers and gate fixes remain on the branch.

objects.spec_clause: §17.4 plugin-defined CC/R lowering; §4.4 unique function identities; §19.5 comparison-link addresses preserved
objects.reason: Standalone function-pointer identities now trigger unified layout and reserve addresses before the heap/interface ranges. Function bodies, results and fault behavior are unchanged; symbol/function order and derived hashes may change.
